goals: Serve a finite /health endpoint from the task worktree using the port leased by RuntimeManager
Gate acceptance on the leased URL: verifyCommands fetch CLIYARD_WEB_URL/health and require HTTP 200 with { ok: true }
nonGoals: Do not start a long-lived dev server; the Verifier owns the service lifecycle
Do not add browser, screenshot, or accessibility checks
verifyCommands: node -e "const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const base=process.env.CLIYARD_WEB_URL;assert.ok(base,'CLIYARD_WEB_URL was not injected');assert.equal(base,process.env.WEB_URL,'WEB_URL alias mismatch');fetch(base+'/health').then(async (res)=>{assert.equal(res.status,200);const body=await res.json();assert.equal(body.ok,true);assert.equal(body.cwd,process.cwd(),'service cwd is not the task worktree');console.log('runtime verifier OK: '+base);}).catch((error)=>{console.error(error);process.exit(1);});"
